question: Eight friends K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting anticlockwise around a circular table facing the center in the same sequence with equal distances between them. If M is sitting in the southwest direction, then in which direction is P sitting?
solution:
**Eight friends: **K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R

1) All are sitting anticlockwise around a circular table facing the center in the same sequence with equal distance. If M is sitting in the southwest direction.

(We have to arrange accordingly so that M is to face toward southwest direction)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b0ffa8efc6ce7d8dc6607ac81359a069e349d2c6a193acd3a957f8b0032f7ec.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **P **is sitting in **East **direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"East".**
